title: Ukraine Launches Record Drone Barrage on Russia; Moscow Says 1,336 Intercepted
detail: Russia's Defence Ministry said it downed 1,336 Ukrainian drones, the most in a single attack since the full-scale invasion. About 600 flew toward Moscow region, 191 shot down on approach per Mayor Sobyanin. Drones struck the Ilsky oil refinery in Krasnodar (six wounded) and Azov in Rostov (three wounded); Ukraine said it hit two oil depots in Azov. Figures are Russian MoD claims.
